note: The current best endgame / meta Aniimo teams, compiled from and corroborated across several up-to-date guides (games.gg, allthings.how, oslink). Each member's Held Item, personality and stat priority is pulled from our per-Aniimo build data (Game8) and links to that Aniimo's full page. Team metas shift with every patch — this is a curated snapshot, dated above.

teams.name: Electric Burst
teams.why: The premier burst team for PvP and fast clears: Blazen breaks stance, Luminelle and Turbo double-buff, and Fulmintis — the top Electric carry — slams the damage window shut. No healer, so it's high-risk, high-reward against anything you can't kill fast.

teams.name: Dark One-Shot
teams.why: Built around one enormous damage window rather than steady damage: Dreaple and Fragrancier stack Dark-resistance shred and buffs, Inferlupa opens the break, and Pawney's ultimate lands at full value. The go-to boss-deleter.

teams.name: Sherro Water
teams.why: Balances offense and defense for late-game content: Panpanta and Piopiota flood the arena with water puddles that amplify Sherro's Water damage, while Prismana Glacy keeps the combo running through long fights.

teams.name: Lightning Bruiser
teams.why: A reliable PvE Electric team that keeps a dedicated healer — it trades the burst team's raw speed for the survivability to grind out long fights safely.

teams.name: Fire Detonation
teams.why: A dependable Fire composition for PvE: Magmarex controls through Break, Flamerion feeds the team energy, and Glacy sustains while Infergon carries the damage.

teams.name: Grass Crit
teams.why: Keeps a fragile crit carry alive: Thornblade sits behind Melloblum's buffs, Somniwing's energy and Glacy's healing, turning sustained uptime into steady PvE damage.

teams.name: Dark Mark & Burst
teams.why: An all-Dark mark-and-burst core that scales from progression into endgame: Fragrancier's debuffs and Hexxin's curses feed Stellarys' energy and damage while Rookey opens the break window.
